product.title: 4 Hour Private Tour: Explore Acadia Nat'l Park, Fjord & Mansions

description.text: Explore Acadia National Park on a private half-day guided drive covering Park Loop Road highlights and Cadillac Mountain views without required climbing. Your guide personalizes pacing through fjord overlooks, gardens, and mansion corridors near Somes Sound. Stops include Cadillac Mountain, Park Loop Road, Somes Sound, Asticou Gardens. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.

highlights: Get personalized recommendations and information from your tour guide
Cover the Park Loop Road, with panoramic views from Cadillac Mountain—no climbing necessary
Tours include private transfers in a climate-controlled vehicle
